name: mirage
text: Good question, I checked. The paid APIs are fine (PropLine used 1,058 of 250,000 requests today, plenty of room) and the scan now prices ~15,000 lines. The gap is the specific legs Novig's buyers pick: (a) the other side of a market the scan priced, which I fixed earlier; (b) player props like anytime touchdown / receiving yards (blocked unless priced at a premium, now allowed); (c) games Novig lists that no book carries (small college games, challenger tennis). Right now 58% of requests are still skipped for 'no fair line' on a freshly restarted scan. I'm pulling the next journal (it lands in ~15 min) to list exactly which league/market legs are still missing and fix those next.
